set.body:
Outcome: Resolve reproduced consumer gaps GitHub #1, #2, #3 against 37a48d55891409a861aa517a508459ff9f07fb50.
Scope: Generic neutral/progress status roles, public dot+label composition, explicit System-weight contract, standalone table-header sizing and native regressions. Partial C1/C4 work only; no full C4, provider qualification, scientific policy or pin changes.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Both palettes have neutral/progress roles, distinct from selection/focus, with label >=4.5:1 and dot >=3:1 on canvas/shell/raised (and selection contexts).
- [ ] Java-callable StatusIndicator supports semantic classes, caller label as accessible text, updates and text enlargement; sampler renders all five roles in both densities/appearances.
- [ ] Document native System 400/700 contract, historical study 500->400 / 600->700 mapping and qualified platform limits; probe every emitted theme weight with explicit face expectations.
- [ ] Reproduce standalone header issue, correct to12px Regular for all4variants and retain registered/text-scale path; remove dead bold rule; regenerate byte-identical resources.
- [ ] Retain source/commands/exits/native/computed evidence, preserve locked originals and provider pin, reconcile Mote.
Relevant: tokens/meridian.json; tools/generate_tokens.py; theme-build/_recipes.scss; MeridianAppearance; workbench StatusIndicator; sampler ConsumerContractProbe; docs/THEMING.md; tests.
Checks: Python full token/theme suite, generator --check, compiler --check/--verify, foundation verifier, sbt compile/format/package, native contract probe + ThemeSmoke.
Risks: JavaFX em cascades and platform face substitution. Only macOS is currently qualified; do not infer Linux/Windows qualification.
Next: retain native baseline, then bounded edits and computed/render checks.
set.title: Fix consumer-reported status and typography contracts (#1–#3)
